title: アグネスデジタル登場！

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hiya! I'm Agnes Digital, the all-rounder-ish Umamusume who'll run on dirt or turf just to be side-by-side with all my oshis! ☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for me to make my debut, and the news has somehow made its way to T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Why are they worrying about me?! Ooohhh, I'm not so sure about this race anymore!
